+1 — This also affects **ACP downstream platforms** (e.g. Discord, Slack) when opencode is used via `opencode acp`.

## Reproduction via ACP

When opencode runs as an ACP agent behind a platform bridge (like [OpenAB](https://github.com/openabdev/openab)), the compacted planning block (Goal / Constraints & Preferences / Progress / Blocked / Next Steps / Critical Context / Relevant Files) is included in the `result.content[].text` returned via JSON-RPC.

The downstream platform has no way to distinguish this internal orchestration state from the actual answer — it renders **everything** to the end user.

## Observed behavior (ACP mode)

- Each tool call iteration appends another full planning dump to the response
- A single user question produces 6-7 repetitions of the planning block before the actual answer
- Internal state (model name, base URL, file paths) is leaked to end users
- Model: Gemma 4 31B-IT via vLLM (non-Claude/GPT models are more susceptible, consistent with the original report)

## Impact

For ACP consumers this is not just a UX annoyance — it is:
1. **Information leakage** (internal infra details exposed to users)
2. **Token waste** (repeated planning blocks consume output tokens)
3. **Unusable output** (users see walls of planning text before getting the actual answer)

## Suggested fix scope

Whatever fix is applied for the Desktop UI should also ensure the compaction summary format does not leak into the text parts returned via ACP `session/prompt` responses. Ideally the planning state should only be emitted via `SessionUpdate::Plan` (ref #30659), not as raw text in the assistant message.

Confirmed this root-cause fix locally on macOS/Bun.

Verification in a clean PR worktree:
- `bun install --ignore-scripts`
- `bun --cwd packages/tui typecheck` passed
- Direct repro check: `@solid-primitives/scheduled` debounce did not update a Solid signal under the current Bun/Node resolution path
- Direct fix check: `packages/tui/src/util/signal.ts#createDebouncedSignal` did update the signal after the debounce window

This matches the reported `/sessions` behavior: the search input changes, but the debounced search signal never fires, so the session list remains unfiltered. PR #31211 looks like the correct root-cause fix rather than just masking the loading fallback.

This issue is related to several others that all stem from the same root cause — shared SQLite state without cross-process isolation:
- #28249 — "Parallel terminal sessions overlap when running in the same project directory" (same scenario, focuses on file edit/snapshot corruption)
- #21215 — "opencode run: concurrent sessions crash with SQLITE_BUSY (busy_timeout=0)" (same root cause, manifests as crashes rather than silent sharing)
- #21443 — "Multi-pane/window setup Fails (1.4.0 - SqliteError)" (same root cause, second instance cannot open the WAL DB)
- #30302 — "opencode serve: multiple instances sharing ~/.config/opencode and ~/.local/share/opencode lose sessions and show broken MCP status after v1.15.11" (serve mode, same shared state problem)

Not an exact duplicate of any of them, but they all describe the same underlying design gap. Fixing the database contention / instance isolation at the core would resolve all of these together.
